sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Candidate is semantically faithful and deterministic validation is valid. It preserves the required ship target and owner paths, certificate/document evidence, class draught operands with units, supplied assessment date, draught comparison direction, cutoff date, and corrected pre-2007 deadline logic. Direct constraints cover the marking evidence with canonical datatypes and units, and the marking draught is compared to the certificate maximum amidships draught.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Reject: the draught comparison direction is reversed. A summer load-line draught located at a higher level than the UIWL corresponds to summerDraught < uiwlDraught, so the marking branches must apply on that strict condition; equality must remain in the no-marking branch. Correct all post-2007 and pre-2007 conditional branches accordingly. Also add direct SHACL constraints for warningTrianglePresent, iceClassDraughtMarkPresent, and iceClassDraughtMarkDraughtAmidships on their declared ship owner, including their canonical datatypes and, for the mark quantity, qudt:QuantityValue with unit:M and decimal numeric value. These terms are currently only queried, so malformed or unitless evidence can pass.

Reject. Preserve the prior draught-direction and direct-evidence instructions, but repair the pre-2007 applicability logic: when marking evidence is complete, the ship must pass without requiring firstScheduledDryDockingDate; when marking evidence is incomplete, the date must be present, and the ship may pass only if that date is after assessmentDate, while markings are required when it is on or before assessmentDate. The current branch instead requires incomplete markings and passes when the docking date is absent or on/before assessmentDate, creating accidental passes and reversing the deadline logic. Also enforce that iceClassDraughtMarkDraughtAmidships equals the class certificate's maximumIceClassDraughtAmidships; querying only for presence of a mark value does not encode the required maximum-permissible-draught relationship.

Candidate is semantically faithful and deterministic validation is valid. It preserves the required ship target and owner paths, certificate/document evidence, class draught operands with units, supplied assessment date, draught comparison direction, cutoff date, and corrected pre-2007 deadline logic. Direct constraints cover the marking evidence with canonical datatypes and units, and the marking draught is compared to the certificate maximum amidships draught.
